theater: 暹羅灣與湄公河中下游

battle.name: 法暹戰爭
battle.theater: 暹羅灣與湄公河中下游
battle.brief: 一八九三年七月，法國兩艘砲艦溯昭披耶河駛入曼谷灣，炮擊帕南要塞、封鎖河口，逼迫暹羅割讓湄公河以東的寮國並賠款，簽訂《曼谷條約》。此役靠的是艦炮、後膛步槍與後膛炮，加特林機槍在歐洲已退出一線軍備，僅作為同時代速射火力的原型被記錄。

kit.name: 加特林機槍
kit.history: 六根管子用人力轉動。它的後坐力分散在六次上，所以能壓住一個師。

countries: 交戰的兩方是法國第三共和國與暹羅王國，但爭議並不發生在兩國本土之間，而是發生在法屬印度支那的邊境與湄公河的水道上。法國一方由殖民部主管，總理兼殖民部部長朱爾·費里在一八九三年推動把交趾支那、柬埔寨與東京保護國連成一體；實際軍政由西貢的殖民政府與北部的安南軍政分掌，投入邊境衝突的骨幹是法國遠東分艦隊的兩艘砲艦與安南籍步槍射手。暹羅一方是朱拉隆功王治下的拉達洛軒王朝，中央設國防部與陸軍總司令部，首都曼谷有暹羅王國海軍的小型砲艦隊與昭披耶河口的要塞守備隊，邊境由馬德望府與那空府兩名總督分轄，各府的兵役、河船與大象隊構成本地後方。全戰最醒目的旁觀者是英國：英商在曼谷與香港之間的轉口貿易倚賴暹羅的米與錫，英國駐曼谷的外交官全程在旁記錄並向倫敦報告；中國則因與暹羅的藩屬關係而密切關注，但沒有出兵。
countriesEn: The two parties to the conflict were the French Third Republic and the Kingdom of Siam, but the quarrel was fought neither between the two metropolitan countries nor on their own soil; it was fought on the frontier of French Indochina and on the waterway of the Mekong. On the French side the ministry of the colonies was in charge, and the prime minister and minister of the colonies Jules Ferry pressed in 1893 to weld Cochinchina, Cambodia and the protectorate of Tonkin into a single entity. In practice the military and civil affairs were divided between the colonial government at Saigon and the Annamite administration in the north, and the force actually committed to the frontier clash was the core of two gunboats of the French Far Eastern naval division together with Annamite tirailleurs. On the Siamese side stood the Rattanakosin kingdom under King Chulalongkorn, with a ministry of war and a general staff at the centre, a flotilla of small gunboats of the Royal Siamese Navy in Bangkok, and the garrison of the forts at the mouth of the Chao Phraya; the frontier was divided between the governors of Battambang and of Nong Khai, and the provincial levies, river craft and elephant trains formed the local rear. The most conspicuous bystander of the whole war was Britain: the entrepot trade in Siamese rice and tin between Bangkok and Hong Kong depended on the kingdom's ports, and the British diplomatic officer in Bangkok watched the business throughout and reported it to London. China, bound to Siam by a tributary relationship, followed the affair closely but sent no troops.
people: 關鍵人物分在兩邊。朱拉隆功王是暹羅最後的決策者：他不肯接受法方的最後通牒，也不肯為一場會燒到曼谷的戰爭冒險，於是選擇拖延與討價還價，最後在八月批准割讓。外交大臣 Devawongse Varoprakar 是談判的主持者，他一面向法使熱拉爾交涉，一面向宮廷主張先談後戰，並在年底遣團赴巴黎陳情。邊防的實際執行者是那空府總督披耶汶納達里拉，他主張在湄公河東岸築壘、拒絕法軍過境；一八九三年底法軍越境攻佔清萊府一帶要塞時，正是他調集的援軍把要塞奪回。宮廷中主管內政與人事的丹隆·拉差努帕主持徵兵與糧餉，替談判撐住後方的底子。法國方面，總理兼殖民部部長費里是推動者，外交由巴黎的總理府與殖民部共同決策，遠東的軍事壓力交由海軍殖民地分艦隊執行，熱拉爾被派駐曼谷遞交最後通牒，另有安南籍部隊的指揮官隨法軍行動。曼谷的華商、僑居的歐洲商人與香港的英商代表在幕後穿梭斡旋，英國駐曼谷的外交官屢次向倫敦報告，並建議以聯合仲裁壓制法國。
peopleEn: The decisive figures were divided between the two sides. King Chulalongkorn was the last decision-maker in Siam: he would not accept the French ultimatum, and he would not gamble on a war that might burn Bangkok, so he chose delay and haggling and in August finally approved the cession. The minister for foreign affairs, Devawongse Varoprakar, directed the negotiations; he dealt with the French envoy Gerard on one side and argued before the court for talking before fighting on the other, and at the end of the year he sent an embassy to Paris to state the case. The man who actually executed the frontier defence was the governor of Nong Khai, Phraya Buranatrirat, who argued for entrenchments on the east bank of the Mekong and for the refusal of any French crossing; when French troops crossed the river and stormed a fort in the Chiang Rai area at the end of 1893, it was the reinforcements he called up that retook it. In the palace, Damrong Rajanubhab, who handled the interior and personnel, directed recruitment and supply and held the rear together while the diplomats talked. On the French side the driving force was the prime minister and minister of the colonies, Ferry; foreign policy was decided jointly by the prime minister's office in Paris and the colonial ministry, the military pressure in the Far East was delegated to the colonial naval division, and Gerard was posted to Bangkok to deliver the ultimatum, with Annamite commanders operating alongside the French columns. Behind the scenes the Chinese merchants of Bangkok, the European residents and the British traders of Hong Kong moved between the parties, and the British diplomatic officer in Bangkok reported to London again and again, recommending joint arbitration as a way of restraining France.
kits: 卡面這件加特林機槍是一八六〇年理查德·喬丹·加特林發明的六管手搖速射槍：六根槍管繞同一根主軸旋轉，一次裝填同時擊發六發，後坐力分攤在六次循環裡，後來的型號加裝水套，冷卻液靠人力泵打。它是近代機槍的直系祖先，也是同一年代唯一成熟的速射武器：一八六二至六三年美國聯邦軍購進約一百挺，在內戰的彭蒂亞斯戰役與謝南多厄河谷用過；然而到一八九三年，加特林式已被一八八四年Maxim機槍取代，英國海軍同年採用的維克斯機槍更是後來的真答案。所以在一八九三年的暹羅戰場上，加特林機槍並沒有實際列裝，它代表的是一種正在退場的技術。真正決定火力對比的是另一批武器：法軍步兵裝備一八八六年制式Lebel步槍與一八七四年Gras舊槍，炮兵用八十毫米、一百二十毫米野戰炮與一五五毫米攻城炮，兩艘砲艦自帶中口徑艦炮，攻佔要塞後在壘上架設中小口徑速射砲；安南籍射手多持Gras或Lebel步槍，射擊技術平平，射速與據守陣地的紀律卻可靠。暹羅軍隊的槍械以丹麥造十五號Jørgensen步槍數量最多，另有溫徹斯特與馬蒂尼式單發舊槍，數量不多的哈乞開斯後膛步槍是唯一的新銳；火炮以德國克虜伯後膛炮為主，帕南與河口各堡曾換裝阿姆斯特朗後膛炮，守備隊由丹麥籍與義大利籍教練指導射擊。暹羅王國海軍當時只有數艘淺吃水砲艦，能在昭披耶河裡巡弋，遠不足以封鎖河口。運輸方面，法軍靠西貢與海防的蒸汽船沿湄公河輸送，暹羅靠曼谷至那空的北方鐵路與內河船隊，再用牛車與大象把糧彈拆散運往邊寨；雨季五至十月河水暴漲、瀑布與急流逼人，上游補給在乾季反而更安全，這條季節規律兩邊都清楚。
kitsEn: The Gatling gun on the card is a six-barrel hand-cranked rapid-fire weapon invented in 1860 by Richard Jordan Gatling: six barrels revolve about a single axis, a single loading fills and fires six rounds at the same instant, the recoil is spread over six cycles of rotation, and later models were fitted with a water jacket whose coolant was pumped by hand. It is the direct ancestor of the modern machine gun and was the only mature rapid-fire weapon of its generation. The federal government of the United States bought about a hundred of them in 1862 and 1863, and they were used in the Petersburg campaign and in the Shenandoah valley. By 1893, however, the Gatling had been superseded by the Maxim of 1884, and the Vickers gun adopted by the British navy in that same year of 1893 was the real answer for the future. So the Gatling gun was in no way actually in service on a battlefield in Siam in 1893; it stands here for a technology on its way out. What really decided the fire balance in this conflict was a different set of weapons. French infantry carried the Model 1886 Lebel rifle and the older Model 1874 Gras; the artillery park held 80-millimetre and 120-millimetre field guns together with 155-millimetre siege pieces; the two gunboats carried their own medium-calibre ship guns, and after taking the fort the French emplaced small-calibre rapid-fire pieces in the works. Annamite tirailleurs were armed mostly with Gras or Lebel rifles, unremarkable in marksmanship but reliable in rate of fire and in holding their ground. On the Siamese side the most numerous arm was the Danish fifteen-bore Jorgensen rifle, accompanied by a few Winchester and Martini single-shot weapons, and the scarce Hotchkiss bolt rifle was the only genuinely modern item. Siamese artillery was largely Krupp breech-loading; the forts at Pak Nam and at the river mouth were rearmed with Armstrong breech-loading guns, and the coastal crews were drilled in gunnery by Danish and Italian instructors. The Royal Siamese Navy then possessed only a handful of shallow-draft gunboats, enough to patrol the Chao Phraya but far too few to seal the mouth. On the logistic side the French moved men and stores by steamer from Saigon and Haiphong up the Mekong, while Siam used the northern railway from Bangkok to Nong Khai, river craft, and then bullock carts and elephants to break the loads up and carry them to the frontier posts. The monsoon set the rhythm: from May to October the river ran high and fast with falls and rapids in the way, so that supply to the upper reaches was in fact easier in the dry season, and both sides knew that rule well enough.
tactics: 這場衝突的戰術骨架是「艦砲逼簽」。法國沒有在陸上尋求會戰，而是把兩艘吃水淺、火力猛的砲艦直接開進昭披耶河，溯流而上直到曼谷灣口，再派海軍陸戰隊在帕南登岸、奪取暹羅砲台、拆走守軍的火砲並換上自己的速射砲，隨即以封鎖河口代替進攻曼谷：河口的商船被扣，暹羅最依賴的海路出口被捏住，前線實際上退到曼谷城牆與宮廷這一線。暹羅的對應是以河防對封鎖：帕南、昭披耶河兩岸與各支汊口設砲台，阿姆斯特朗後膛炮佈於壘後，皇家海軍的小型砲艦在河口與上游巡弋，府兵則在內陸沿線集結，準備在曼谷下游平原迎擊法軍登陸隊。談判與軍事施壓同步進行：法方遞交限期八日的最後通牒，暹羅一面拖延、一面把使團送往巴黎，試圖引入英國與清國的仲裁。北方戰線在年底另行展開：法軍與安南援軍自清萊一帶渡過湄公河，攻佔暹羅在右岸修築的要塞，暹羅援軍在叢林與山間的窄路上反攻奪回，雙方在雨季泥濘、瘧疾與運力不足的限制下打了幾天，終因法方援軍與彈藥到位而不了了之；整條邊界線上的實際控制，最後還是要靠一八九六年的勘界測量與一八九七年的界碑確定。
tacticsEn: The tactical skeleton of this conflict was gunboat diplomacy. France did not seek a set-piece battle on land. She sent two shallow-draft, powerfully armed gunboats straight up the Chao Phraya until they lay off the mouth of Bangkok Bay, landed marines at Pak Nam, took the Siamese battery, removed the garrison guns and mounted her own rapid-fire pieces in their place, and then substituted the blockade of the river mouth for an assault on Bangkok: merchant ships at the mouth were detained, the maritime outlet on which Siam depended was pinched shut, and the front line in practice fell back to the city walls of Bangkok and the palace. Siam answered a blockade with a river defence: batteries at Pak Nam, along both banks of the Chao Phraya and at the mouths of the tributaries, Armstrong breech-loading guns emplaced behind earthworks, the small gunboats of the Royal Siamese Navy patrolling the mouth and the upper river, and the provincial levies assembling inland to meet a landing on the plains below Bangkok. Negotiation and military pressure ran side by side: Paris delivered an ultimatum with an eight-day deadline, while Siam stalled, sent an embassy to Paris and tried to draw in British arbitration and Chinese backing. A second front opened in the north at the end of the year. French troops with Annamite auxiliaries crossed the Mekong in the Chiang Rai area and stormed the fort the Siamese had built on the right bank; Siamese reinforcements counter-attacked along the narrow jungle and mountain tracks and retook it. Mud of the monsoon, malaria and a shortage of transport kept both sides from pressing the advantage, and the affair ended without resolution, since the French reinforcements and their ammunition came in. The effective line of control along the whole frontier was in the end fixed not by battle but by the survey of 1896 and the boundary stones set up in 1897.
data: 可核對的數字集中在條約與艦隊兩處。依一八八三年《曼谷條約》，暹羅割讓湄公河以東之地並支付五十萬法郎賠償，法方則支付八十萬法郎給暹羅，並承諾興建由曼谷通往湄公河畔的鐵路——這條鐵路此後二十年未曾動工。一八九三年《曼谷條約》規定：暹羅割讓湄公河以東全部土地、支付五十萬法郎賠償，法方就割讓支付一百萬法郎；法方原議的鐵路改為從寬處理，欠款留待日後結清。軍力方面，暹羅常備軍連同各府兵役在八九三年約一萬人上下，另有運象與挑夫數千，皇家海軍可用的小型砲艦不到十艘；法國在交趾支那與東京的常備軍連同安南籍部隊以數千計，真正投入邊境者人數更少。八九十年間暹羅的對外貿易總值約在數百萬至千萬銀塔勒之間，出口以米、錫、茶與柚木為主，其中相當一部分經曼谷轉口香港。砲兵方面，帕南要塞與曼谷各堡在八九〇年代初完成一次現代化換裝，換上阿姆斯特朗與克虜伯後膛炮，舊式前膛炮則集中於內河小堡。一八九三年七月十三日帕南交火中，暹羅有一艘砲艦在河口外被擊中沉沒；法軍登陸部隊不足兩百人，暹羅河口守軍數百人，傷亡記錄零星。暹羅海軍的砲艦多為木殼、無裝甲，在與艦炮對射的場合吃了大虧。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked are concentrated in two places, the treaties and the naval force. Under the Treaty of Bangkok of 1883 Siam ceded the lands east of the Mekong and paid an indemnity of 500,000 francs, while France paid Siam 800,000 francs and undertook to build a railway from Bangkok to the banks of the Mekong; that railway was never to be laid for the next twenty years. The Treaty of Bangkok of 1893 laid down that Siam should cede all territory east of the Mekong and pay an indemnity of 500,000 francs, and that France should pay Siam 1,000,000 francs for the cession; the railway promised by France was treated leniently and the outstanding sums were left to be settled later. On military strength, the Siamese regular army together with the provincial levies numbered some ten thousand men in 1893, with several thousand more employed as elephant drivers and carriers, and the Royal Siamese Navy had fewer than ten small gunboats available. The French regulars in Cochinchina and Tonkin, with their Annamite troops, numbered several thousand, and the force actually committed to the frontier was smaller still. The foreign trade of Siam in the 1880s and 1890s was worth between several million and some ten million silver ticals a year, the exports being rice, tin, tea and teak, a considerable share of which was re-exported through Bangkok to Hong Kong. On the artillery side, the forts at Pak Nam and the batteries at Bangkok had gone through a modernisation in the early 1890s and been rearmed with Armstrong and Krupp breech-loading guns, while the older muzzle-loaders were concentrated in the small river forts. In the clash at Pak Nam on 13 July 1893 one Siamese gunboat was struck and sunk off the mouth of the river; the French landing party numbered fewer than two hundred men and the Siamese garrison at the mouth several hundred, and the casualty record is scattered and small. The Siamese gunboats were mostly wooden and unarmoured, and they suffered badly in an exchange of fire with naval guns.
cause: 起因是一條水道與一條鐵路的爭執。一八六〇年代以來，法國一直想讓湄公河成為通雲南的航道，理由是河谷貿易與雲南的紅河水系相連，而暹羅控制著中下游的航權；一八六七年法暹條約已把湄公河定為法暹邊界並承認法國船隻的通航權，但法國要求的是由上游國家負責疏浚、護航與開放商埠，這些都超出暹羅的能力與意願。一八八三年《曼谷條約》割地之後，鐵路承諾與八十萬法郎的款項成了法國手上的把柄，而暹羅方面普遍認為割地已經了結，兩邊對同一條款的理解從此分歧。緊接著是一八八八年馬德望府邊境的衝突，一支法軍巡隊遭暹羅官軍攻擊，史稱馬德望事件：法國歸咎於馬德望總督，要求五十萬法郎賠償並撤換該總督，暹羅朝廷拒絕，此後數年邊境摩擦不斷，法國也一再聲明琅勃拉邦一帶的寮國「早已屬於安南」。到八九三年，法國把要求合併成一份清單：接受法國公使常駐曼谷、支付賠款、承認法國對琅勃拉邦與湄公河東岸的主權。法方判斷曼谷可以欺騙——朝廷虛張聲勢、邊軍無力，海軍卻足以在數小時內開到城下。暹羅無法在外交上取得法國的讓步，英國又明確表示不會為此與法國開戰，中國的藩屬體系也早已不能提供保護，於是只剩一條路：先答應部分條件、拖延並談判，同時把軍隊調到河口與北方，讓法方明白登陸與攻取曼谷的代價不低。
causeEn: The cause lay in a quarrel over one waterway and one railway. From the 1860s France had been trying to make the Mekong the road to Yunnan, on the ground that the trade of the river valley connected with the Red River system of Yunnan while Siam held the navigation rights on the middle and lower course. The Franco-Siamese treaty of 1867 had already fixed the Mekong as the Franco-Siamese frontier and acknowledged the right of French ships to navigate it, but what France asked for was that the upstream state should keep the channel dredged, escorted the traffic and opened markets to foreign trade, and all of that lay beyond the capacity and the willingness of Siam. After the cession of 1883, the promise of the railway and the sum of 800,000 francs became a handle in the French hand, while on the Siamese side it was widely held that the cession had settled the matter; the two governments read the same clause in opposite ways from that point on. Immediately afterwards came the clash of 1888 on the frontier of Battambang, when a French patrol was attacked by Siamese troops, an episode known as the Battambang incident: France blamed the governor of Battambang, demanded 500,000 francs in indemnity and the removal of that governor, and the Siamese court refused. Frontier friction continued for years, and France repeatedly declared that the Laos country round Luang Prabang had belonged to Annam for long. By 1893 Paris merged its demands into a single list: the acceptance of a French consul permanently resident at Bangkok, the payment of an indemnity, and the recognition of French sovereignty over Luang Prabang and the east bank of the Mekong. The French judged that Bangkok could be bullied, that the court would bluster, that the frontier troops were powerless, and that the navy could reach the city in a matter of hours. Siam could obtain no diplomatic concession from France, Britain made it clear that it would not go to war over the matter, and the Chinese tributary order could no longer offer protection. There was one course left: accept part of the terms, stall and negotiate, and at the same time move troops to the river mouth and to the north, so that Paris would understand that a landing and the taking of Bangkok would not be cheap.
impact: 影響在兩個方向上拉開。對法國與法屬印度支那：寮國與柬埔寨的歸屬被寫進條約，一八九五年法屬印度支那聯合體成立、一八九七年設總督，河西岸的「雲南通道」框架成形，法國在東亞的戰略縱深從此連成一片。對暹羅：曼谷不再是可以左右區域的緩衝王國，湄公河下游與昭披耶河流域成為國土核心，卻在一八九〇年代末連失邊境據點；一九〇四年與一九〇七年的附約再把湄公河右岸的清廉、芒方等府以及北部數地割出，換得約八百萬法郎，暹羅的國界線第一次完全沿河與山脊重畫，與英屬緬甸、法屬印度支那三方接壤的格局成形。軍事的教訓更直接：一八九三年的敗仗證明舊式宮廷軍與府兵不足以與現代化部隊對抗，暹羅於是加速整編——新式步槍與克虜伯、阿姆斯特朗後膛炮成批輸入，陸軍總司令部與參謀本部的制度成形，砲兵與工兵獨立建制，一八九〇年代中期以後海軍在丹麥籍顧問指導下重建，首都與各府普遍築起新式城塞，本世紀初的徵兵法把常備兵役制寫進法典，幾乎與法國當年施壓的節奏對拍。外交上，這場衝突示範了近代砲艦對主權國家的威懾力，此後十年間列強在亞洲反覆使用同一手法，東亞的海權政治從此多了一條不成文的規則：凡涉及內陸航道的爭端，最後都由海軍裁決。
impactEn: The effects pulled in two directions. For France and for French Indochina, the attribution of Laos and Cambodia was written into a treaty, the Indochinese Union was formed in 1895 and a governor-general appointed in 1897, the framework of a road to Yunnan on the far side of the river took shape, and the French strategic depth in East Asia was joined into a single piece. For Siam, Bangkok was no longer a buffer kingdom able to hold the balance of the region; the lower Mekong and the basin of the Chao Phraya became the core of the country, yet frontier posts were still lost in the late 1890s. The conventions of 1904 and 1907 took away further districts on the right bank of the Mekong, Chiang Kham and Muang Fang among them, together with ground in the north, in exchange for roughly eight million francs. Siam's frontier was for the first time redrawn entirely along rivers and ridges, and the geography in which it touched British Burma and French Indochina took its final form. The military lesson was blunter still: the defeat of 1893 proved that the old palace troops and the provincial levies could not stand against modernised forces, and Siam set about reorganising. New rifles and Krupp and Armstrong breech-loading guns came in batches, the system of the general staff and of the army headquarters took shape, artillery and engineers became separate branches, and after the middle of the 1890s the navy was rebuilt under Danish advisers. New forts were thrown up in the capital and in the provincial capitals, and the conscription law of the early twentieth century wrote a standing army into the statute book, almost keeping time with the rhythm of the pressure France had applied. Diplomatically the conflict demonstrated the coercive power of modern gunboats against sovereign states, and the same method was used again and again by the powers in Asia over the following decade. East Asian sea-power politics acquired an unwritten rule: every quarrel touching an inland waterway was ultimately adjudicated by a navy.
result: 結果是法國以極小的代價拿到了它要的東西。一八九三年八月十五日簽訂的《曼谷條約》規定：暹羅割讓湄公河以東全部土地並承認法國對寮國與柬埔寨的主權，支付五十萬法郎賠償；法國就割讓支付一百萬法郎，承認一八八三年承諾的鐵路暫不興建，欠款留待後議；暹羅接納法國公使，並同意法國商人在曼谷貿易與置業，法國在河口與上游的兵船得以在條約簽訂後撤退。表面上法國只是「駁回」一場小型邊界衝突，實際上等於用兩艘砲艦換取了中南半島的一半。暹羅沒有被征服，曼谷未被攻陷，朱拉隆功王朝仍然存在，國庫也沒有被勒索到破產，這是本場戰爭最不尋常的地方。但條約簽訂並沒有帶來立刻的平靜：年底法軍與安南援軍仍在清萊府一帶越境攻擊要塞，暹羅援軍一度奪回，雙方在邊境僵持到翌年；真正的界線要等一八九四至一八九六年的勘界隊沿湄公河逐段測量、一八九七年界碑豎立才算固定。一八九〇年代剩下的幾年裡，法國在暹羅境內的據點只剩下河口的砲艦與領事的駐地，寮國的控制靠駐軍與後來的鐵路維持；暹羅則利用這十幾年重建軍力，一九〇四年法暹關係因暹羅試圖取消法國在湄公河下游的航行特權而再度緊張，最終仍以一九〇七年的條約收場。這場戰爭沒有留下紀念碑，因為它幾乎全程只以條約、勘界與砲艦的口徑存在。
resultEn: The result was that France obtained what it wanted at a very small price. The Treaty of Bangkok signed on 15 August 1893 laid down that Siam should cede all territory east of the Mekong and acknowledge French sovereignty over Laos and Cambodia and pay an indemnity of 500,000 francs, while France should pay Siam 1,000,000 francs for the cession, agree that the railway promised in 1883 would not be built for the time being and leave the outstanding sums to later settlement. Siam received a French envoy and allowed French merchants to trade and own property in Bangkok, and the French warships at the river mouth and on the upper river were able to withdraw once the treaty had been signed. On the face of it France had merely repelled a small frontier incident; in reality it had exchanged two gunboats for half of the Indo-Chinese peninsula. Siam was not conquered, Bangkok was not taken, the Chulalongkorn dynasty survived and the treasury was not ruined, and that is the most unusual feature of the war. The signature of the treaty did not bring immediate quiet. At the end of the year French troops and Annamite auxiliaries were still crossing the river in the Chiang Rai area to attack the fort, the Siamese counter-attacked and retook it, and the two sides remained locked on the frontier into the following year. The real line was not fixed until the survey parties of 1894 to 1896 measured the Mekong section by section and the boundary stones were set up in 1897. Through the remaining years of the 1890s the French presence in Siamian territory was reduced to the gunboats at the river mouth and the residence of the consul, and control of Laos rested on garrisons and, later, on the railway. Siam used the same decade and a half to rebuild its armed forces, and in 1904 relations with France grew tense again when Siam tried to cancel the French right of navigation on the lower Mekong; the matter was finally closed by the treaty of 1907. This war left no monument behind, because for almost its whole course it existed only in the language of treaties, surveys and gunboat calibres.
